properties.displayName: CVE-2026-33824 — Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions Exploitation
properties.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-33824: Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions contains a double free vulnerability that could enable remote code execution.. Product: Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message has "CVE-2026-33824" or RuleName has "CVE-2026-33824" or ProcessName has "CVE-2026-33824" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, EventID | where count_ > 5 // AZ-ENDPOINT-006
